title: Add destination_v32 and terrain training on the surrogate: forward walks with slope inputs
summary: mdp/slope.py estimates each replica's tilt along a slope from its front and rear toes and corrects the policy's gravity inputs or its femur and tibia angle inputs for it; training (DestinationTrainingTask, reward field slope_inputs) and surrogate scenes share it. destination_v32 is destination_v29 with every run a 20 s walk straight ahead at 0.05 to 0.15 m/s and the tilt added to the femur and tibia inputs. locomotion.surrogate.train --terrain trains on a terrain spec's height field, with the touchdown model off and every reset at a random place and heading at least --spawn-margin from the terrain's edge (SurrogateEnv spawn). A scene robot whose checkpoint trained with slope inputs uses them.
next: Fine-tune destination_v32 on a mixed terrain of hills, steps and bumps from the destination_v29 update-600 checkpoint and compare it with destination_v29 on ramp, step and bump scenes.
reason: A named experiment and surrogate options; native training, the canonical task, reward and evaluator are unchanged, and SurrogateEnv without a terrain, start or spawn is unchanged.
